metadata.scope: fixture scan: canned findings, not an audit of this repository's code

executive_summary.prose: A fixture scan: three canned findings recorded through traust so the workflow, dashboards and decisions have something to work on.

severity_criteria.definition: Exploitable with a foothold or a common precondition.
Defense in depth; no direct exploit path.

findings.title: Fixture: SQL built from request input
findings.description: A fixture finding: request input concatenated into a SQL statement lets a caller change the query.

findings.title: Fixture: credential committed to configuration
findings.description: A fixture finding: a static credential in a committed configuration file is readable by anyone with the source.
findings.remediation: Load the credential from a secret store at runtime and rotate it.

findings.title: Fixture: verbose errors reach the caller
findings.description: A fixture finding: internal error detail returned to callers reveals implementation information.
findings.remediation: Return a generic message and log the detail server-side.
